meta.description: Use when users ask how to write, explain, customize, migrate, secure, or troubleshoot GitHub Actions workflows, workflow syntax, triggers, matrices, runners, reusable workflows, artifacts, caching, secrets, OIDC, deployments, custom actions, or Actions Runner Controller, especially when they need official GitHub documentation, exact links, or docs-grounded YAML guidance.

copy.tagline_en: Write and troubleshoot GitHub Actions workflows

howto.what: 当用户询问 GitHub Actions 相关问题时，Claude 会查阅官方文档，给出基于文档的准确答案和链接，而不是凭记忆回答。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何编写、解释、自定义、迁移、安全或排查 GitHub Actions 工作流、语法、触发器、矩阵、运行器、可重用工作流、制品、缓存、密钥、OIDC、部署、自定义操作或 Actions Runner Controller 时触发。
